summary: Anthropic announced a multi-year global alliance with DXC Technology to train Claude-certified forward-deployed engineers and embed Claude into DXC's IT systems serving banks, airlines, insurers and government agencies, building on DXC's internal use of Claude to build its OASIS orchestration platform.

mechanisms.reason: A large-scale rollout of Claude into DXC's systems for major regulated-industry customers implies a substantial increase in aggregate model usage.
mechanisms.quote: DXC will train tens of thousands of Claude-certified forward-deployed engineers (FDEs)—engineers embedded directly inside customer organizations—to bring Claude into the systems DXC operates for the world’s largest banks, airlines, insurers, manufacturers, and government agencies.

practices.reason: The reported 10x speedup and 95% code-generation figure are the lab's own unreplicated case-study metrics rather than a transferable benchmark.
practices.quote: The firm estimates that Claude sped up software development by a factor of 10.

practices.reason: The always-on security subagent describes an agent architecture pattern but is DXC's proprietary build with no implementation detail given.
practices.quote: DXC is developing an always-on security engineer subagent, built on Claude Security, that will be deployed across its security operations centers (SOCs).
